results.note: Asserts that when persist succeeds the plain success ping fires (events==['persisted', f'ping:{HEARTBEAT_URL}']), and when the fetcher returns Unavailable (fetched nothing) the plain success ping never fires — only the distinct /fail ping does (events==['persisted', f'ping:{HEARTBEAT_URL}/fail']). ingest/heartbeat.py:54-58 implements the check (fetch_result.status not in ('OK','STALE') raises before the success ping).

With persist raising RuntimeError, asserts requested_urls == [f'{HEARTBEAT_URL}/fail'] — explicit failure produces a distinct signal (the /fail endpoint) from the plain success ping. True silence (process death before any code runs) is architecturally different again: no ping fires at all, matching ingest/heartbeat.py:56-58's except-block routing.

Client transport raises httpx.ConnectError on every ping; test asserts run_ingestion still returns row_id 42 without raising. ingest/heartbeat.py:30-32 catches httpx.HTTPError inside _ping and swallows it, so a broken monitor cannot fail or block the ingestion run.
